bank_finalizer.role: copy intact into generated Bank as ~finalize_bank.py; regenerates figures, silently applies MathJax v10/final-byte repairs, runs resolved Algebra inventory/response checks, reports focused review notes, creates final ZIP

standalone_mathjax_maintenance.role: framework maintenance/reference copy; optional standalone teacher repair tool, not a third generated-Bank production script

practice_review_rule: Repeated procedural families/skeletons and exact duplicate prompts are allowed. Do not audit duplicate/skeleton frequency. Report only objective issues such as student-facing iteration labels, repeated generic long trailing wrappers, broken math/HTML, bad IDs/files, or high-confidence mechanical unrelated bundles.
final_bytes_rule: Teacher runs self-contained finalizer after extracting authoring-complete Bank ZIP. MathJax v10 repairs are silent unless unresolved; blank solution fields are not report noise; hard structural/profile failures block PASS.
review_view_rule: Finalizer requires unitN_review.html and checks that it renders the same canonical item count as unitN.html/mapping/JSON.
